title: catalyst new, edit, rename, restore, status set, link
description: What a writing verb prints with `--json`: the entity it changed, its file, and every file it touched (back-references and indexes included), each journaled (catalyst >= 0.97.0 describes it). `catalyst edit` of a linked entity by someone other than an admin prints the proposal it opened instead of a file (catalyst >= 0.114.0).

file.description: Its file (absent when an edit was opened as a proposal).

proposal.description: The reconciliation case an edit was opened as, waiting for an admin's decision (`catalyst edit`, design 31).
